project_type: Multi-tenant Enterprise CRM (Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict)
build_system: npm (npm@11.4.2, node>=22). Node is provided via nvm — before ANY node/npm command run: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh". Without this, `node` is not on PATH.
test_framework: Vitest (vitest.config.ts, vitest.setup.ts). Unit tests in tests/unit and tests/dashboard. Testing Library + jsdom.
build_command: npm run build (slow, ~5min; NOT required for these changes — prefer typecheck+lint)
test_command: npm run test:unit (vitest run tests/unit tests/dashboard)
verification_instructions: For each work unit run: (1) npm run typecheck (npx tsc --noEmit), (2) npm run lint (eslint .). Run npm run test:unit when a change touches logic covered by unit tests or when adding tests. `npm run check` runs all three. Full build is not needed and is time-prohibitive. ESLint has a warnings budget (quality:lint uses --max-warnings 46); do NOT increase overall any/eslint-disable counts.
setup_instructions: 1) cd repo. 2) Load nvm as above. 3) npm install (if node_modules missing). 4) npm run typecheck && npm run lint to confirm a green baseline before editing.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET — npm install works. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator handles publishing). Work stays on branch fix/bucket-c-frontend-ux-codequality. Do NOT commit to main. gh REST API works (gh api repos/vinayakss007/nucrm-bigplan-by-vm-enterprise-v2/issues/{n}) but GraphQL-backed gh subcommands fail.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: strict TypeScript, no `any` unless unavoidable, structured logError from @/lib/errors-server for server errors, TanStack Query aspiration for pages, { data, meta?, error? } API envelope aspiration. Branch naming fix/<desc>. One logical change set here (bucket) rather than one-PR-per-issue since orchestrator publishes a single PR.
key_patterns: IMPORTANT: issue line numbers are STALE/drift-prone — locate the actual code pattern, do not trust line numbers. Several issues are ALREADY (partly) fixed: forms page pagination is already single (#1116/#1343 done), services page mostly uses bg-card/border-border (#1194/#1115 largely done), test-js is already gated behind NODE_ENV (#1345 largely done), issue #1293 is CLOSED (skip).
